result.summary: Several layout and visual problems: truncated restaurant names, a category chip cut off, a loading spinner over a popular restaurant card, and the last featured card cropped by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last restaurant in Fastest near you (Trattoria Piccol...) is clipped at the right edge so the name and image are incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal list enough trailing padding or allow full-card peek so names and images are not cut off.

issues.description: The last category chip (after Healthy) is cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding to the chip row or make the last chip fully visible so users can see and tap all categories.

issues.description: A large loading spinner overlays the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, making the card look unfinished or broken.
issues.suggestion: Hide or replace the spinner once the image is loaded, or use a skeleton that does not cover the whole photo.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card is partially hidden behind the tab bar, so the image and details are cropped.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card is fully visible when scrolling.

issues.description: Restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis or wrap.
issues.suggestion: Use ellipsis or allow two-line titles so names remain readable.
